audit.why: FAVOURED / 4/10 fits 53.75% over 160 games with Singed only owning levels 1-2. Chart matches the packet.
audit.corrected: Left at FAVOURED, 4/10; the quoted win rate 54.55% corrected to 53.75%.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike is written as if Highlander solves Singed outright.
audit.why: Highlander's immunity covers slows only. Mega Adhesive also GROUNDS, which shuts off Alpha Strike, and a Fling that lands you in the goo ROOTS you. Level 6 is still a big spike, but only if you fight outside the puddle.
audit.corrected: Level 6 stated as slow immunity plus the grounding caveat; first item spike keyed to trading before Insanity Potion is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slots are swapped throughout the full layer: Fling is called 'his W' and Mega Adhesive 'his (E)'; phases[0].why calls Poison Trail 'his W'. Three decisive interactions are absent entirely.
audit.why: Riot's slots: Q Poison Trail, W Mega Adhesive (grounding, 13-17s), E Fling (knockup, 8-10s), R Insanity Potion. Missing: Mega Adhesive grounds Alpha Strike; Fling cancels the Meditate channel; Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, halving Meditate.
audit.corrected: Slots fixed; grounding, the Meditate cancel and the Grievous Wounds timing written into spikes, mid, late and the full-layer interaction section.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers on the punish window.

edits.before: Your Highlander (R) at 6 gives you the movespeed and attack speed to stick on Singed even through his W slow and passive speed, and his fling-into-tower play stops working once you can Q his poison trail off cooldown. This is a clean win window for you.
edits.after: Highlander (R) at 6 makes you immune to the Mega Adhesive (W) slow, but the goo also grounds - stand in it and Alpha Strike is locked out entirely. Fight around the puddle, not through it, and his fling-into-tower play stops working. A clean win window.

edits.before: With a first item your sustained DPS shreds Singed's tanky build faster than his poison ticks you, and Meditate (W) heals through his Poison Trail. Just avoid getting flung into his team; in a straight 1v1 you win handily.
edits.after: With a first item your sustained DPS shreds his tanky build faster than the poison ticks you, but Insanity Potion (R) makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds - once he drinks it your Meditate heals for half, so force the fight before it.

edits.before: From level 3 the lane flips your way because Alpha Strike (Q) dodges his Fling and your sustained DPS badly out-damages his weak early poison, and by 4-6 Highlander (R) lets you glue onto him through the W slow.
edits.after: From level 3 the lane flips your way: Alpha Strike (Q) untargets through his Fling (E) on its 8-10s, and by 4-6 Highlander (R) ignores the Mega Adhesive slow - but not its grounding, so never Q from inside the goo.

edits.before: At items and beyond you dominate the 1v1 and split; Meditate heals through his poison and your shred melts his tank build, so his only real threat is flinging you into his team or a gank.
edits.after: At items and beyond you dominate the 1v1 and split; your shred melts his tank build, but Fling (E) cancels a Meditate channel outright and his R halves what it heals, so sustain before he commits.

edits.before: Meditate (W) through Poison Trail (Q) to sustain the lane
edits.after: Meditate (W) before his R makes the poison halve your heal

edits.before: Singed's W poison trail and proxy let him deny your CS while your level-1 short range and missing escape mean you just farm with Alpha Strike and concede space.
edits.after: Singed's Poison Trail (Q) and proxy deny your CS while your level-1 short range and missing escape mean you just farm with Alpha Strike and concede space.

edits.before: Singed's W Fling — it's his only repositioning and peel tool and the setup for every gank; when it's down he has nothing to stop you, but a Fling into his Mega Adhesive slow is how a single CC catches you after Alpha Strike.
edits.after: Singed's E Fling — his only repositioning and peel tool and the setup for every gank; when it's down he has nothing to stop you, but a Fling that lands you in Mega Adhesive roots you, and the goo grounds Alpha Strike besides.

edits.before: Track his W Fling cooldown above all — it's his only repositioning/peel tool and the setup for ganks. When Fling is down, that's your free window to commit Wuju autos. Also watch his Mega Adhesive (E) for the slow zone before you ever step forward.
edits.after: Track Fling (E) above all — 10s at rank 1 down to 8s, his only repositioning and peel tool and the gank setup. With it down you commit Wuju autos freely. Mega Adhesive (W) is 13-17s and grounds, so check the ground before you Alpha Strike.

edits.before: Stepping up while his W is available lets him flip you into his minions or team. Only commit autos when Fling is on cooldown.
edits.after: Stepping up while his E is up lets him flip you into his team, or into Mega Adhesive where the landing roots you. Wait for it to be down.

edits.before: Alpha Strike makes you untargetable through his Fling and Mega Adhesive cast windows; Wuju Style's true damage bypasses the armor and HP a drain tank stacks; Meditate out-heals his poison ticks in a sustained fight; Highlander's slow immunity hard-counters Mega Adhesive, the one tool that sets up CC on you.
edits.after: Alpha Strike makes you untargetable through his Fling, but Mega Adhesive grounds it so you cannot blink out of the goo; Wuju Style's true damage bypasses the HP a drain tank stacks; Fling cancels Meditate outright and Insanity Potion halves it with Grievous Wounds; Highlander ignores the adhesive slow but not its grounding.

edits.before: FAVOURED (54.55%): a no-lockdown drain tank can't punish your early or survive your itemized true-damage DPS — discipline against the proxy is the only thing standing between you and a clean win.
edits.after: FAVOURED (53.75%): a drain tank whose only lockdown is Fling can't punish your early or survive your itemized true-damage DPS — discipline against the proxy is what stands between you and a clean win.

notes: The packet suspectName on wants.you[0] ('Use Alpha Strike') is a false positive — Alpha Strike is correct and the line was left alone. The real defect was slot confusion in the full layer, which called Fling 'his W' and Mega Adhesive '(E)'; Fling is E and Mega Adhesive is W. Level chart matches the packet, no chart edits.
